title: Verbs + to-infinitive: want, decide, hope, plan, need
grammarNote:
Инфинитив с "to" (to + infinitive) — после глаголов намерений, решений, надежд и планов.

📌 Глаголы + to + infinitive:

Решения: decide · choose · plan · intend
"I decided to study medicine." · "They plan to visit London."

Желания: want · hope · wish · would like
"I want to pass the IELTS." · "She hopes to get a scholarship."

Ожидания: expect · promise · refuse · agree
"She promised to help." · "He refused to answer."

Другие: learn · manage · fail · need
"I'm learning to drive." · "She managed to finish on time."

⚠️ Типичные ошибки:
❌ "I want studying." → ✅ "I want to study."
❌ "She decided going." → ✅ "She decided to go."
❌ "He promised helping." → ✅ "He promised to help."

grammarTip:
Шпаргалка — gerund vs infinitive:

✅ GERUND (-ing): enjoy · avoid · hate · finish · miss · keep
consider · suggest · mind · deny · admit · practise · risk
"I enjoy SWIMMING." · "She avoids EATING sugar."

✅ INFINITIVE (to + verb): want · need · decide · hope · plan
promise · agree · refuse · expect · manage · fail · choose · learn
"I want TO SWIM." · "She decided TO EAT less sugar."

⚠️ Глаголы которые меняют смысл:
stop + -ing = перестать: "He stopped smoking." (бросил)
stop + to = остановиться чтобы: "He stopped to smoke." (остановился покурить)
remember + -ing = прошлое: "I remember meeting her."
remember + to = не забыть: "Remember to call her."
